title: Kissed Floral Indian Lentils Tagine
description: A fragrant vegan lentil tagine infused with rose petals, kaffir lime and aromatic spices, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Rinse the red lentils under cold water until the water runs clear, then set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a tajine over medium heat until shimmering, then add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle in the cumin seeds and garam masala, toasting for 30 seconds before adding the tomato puree.
Pour in the coconut milk and vegetable broth, then stir in the dried rose petals and kaffir lime leaves.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover the tajine, and let it cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened, fluff gently with a fork and taste, adding salt if desired.
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving, and refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days for meal prep.
